<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

req-0002. The shipped Rust UDS transport cannot observe Held for two independent reasons (an unroutable reply address, and a status matcher keyed to a wire shape the CLI never emits), so a message parked behind a human's approval dialog is reported Delivered. Status frames carry no correlation id anywhere in their lifecycle, which forces positional correlation and therefore one message in flight per connection. Separately, registration adopts a pre-bind row by seat id alone, so a daemon-spawned seat strands a phantom row and loses the rpc_port stamped on it. Two units fix these; the evidence base is first-party and measured (scratch/woodpecker-poc/FINDINGS.md).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Held and Denied are observable on the live wire, not inferred from silence.
- A timeout is never upgraded to Delivered — the honest-receipt vocabulary holds.
- Concurrency is refused at the transport, never guessed at.
- One seat, one row, with the stamped rpc_port surviving onto the row consumers read.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Copilot RPC — plan 109, closed.
- Improving the tmux send-keys path; it is being replaced, not repaired.
- Flipping the crossSessionInbound consent default — that is Jordan's ruling, not this plan's.
- Verb parity, and anything on the prime-governance branch.

<a id="risks-assumptions"></a>

## Risks & Assumptions

r1 A third independent reason Held stays unreachable — retired by making the FIRST commit a live observation test, before any refactor. r2 Building on the fork's spec where it diverges from the installed build — retired by verifying each borrowed claim against Claude CLI 2.1.251; four of six of that spec's Copilot claims diverged when tested, and its status-frame shape is already known wrong. r3 Silently resolving concurrency instead of refusing it — retired by the two-in-flight mutation. r4 An acceptance test written against the spawn response rather than the launched environment — retired by the discriminating arm that re-registers with no fresh allocation. r5 Regressing toward the fork's `acked` — retired by a test that silence is never upgraded past InjectedToTransport. ASSUMPTION, measured not assumed: a reply listener bound inside the recipient's socket namespace is accepted as a routable reply address; verified live 2026-08-31, held receipt returned in 72ms.
